Check Missing Clincoo Env in Preview before Deploy

Empty variables often show up only after release. Failing fast in preview is cheaper.

This article is available in: Indonesia · English

A Clincoo page looks fine in the editor, then fetch fails in production because the host never received the env.

Write a boot function that loads a list of required keys. If any is empty, show a preview banner instead of staying silent.

Keep key names identical in .env.example and the host dashboard. One letter off makes the value undefined.

Paste the key list to AI and ask for a test checklist. Do not ask AI to fill secret values.

Clincoo on blog.clincoo.buzz and app.clincoo.buzz is easier to debug when env is checked before release.
